rounds.reasoning_summary:

To be safe, I think I can state that the cost is within my authorization and recommend moving forward with the vendor CollaboBoard. I need to evaluate two configurations. The first option is 10 full prorated seats for $1,350, which offers persistent access and full features but comes with the concern that external seats may not be fully utilized after 4-6 months. The second option involves a mix: 6 full seats for internal designers and 4 external partners using 90-day contractor passes, which could cost an additional $240. **Calculating seat options**

For the internal option of 6 full seats prorated, the cost comes out to $810. When I add the $240 for the external partners' contractor passes, the total for this option becomes $1,050. I can assume that contractor passes do allow ownership, but if not, that option falls through. rounds.response: Option A — buy 10 full prorated Business seats: 10 × $180 × 9/12 = $1,350 (invoiced immediately); pros: full features, persistent accounts and board ownership for all users, simplest to onboard; cons: slightly higher cost. Option B — mix: 6 internal full seats (6 × $180 × 9/12 = $810) + two 90‑day contractor passes per external (4 externals × $30 × 2 blocks = $240) = $1,050; pros: saves ~$300, cons: contractor passes have limited admin and vendor has not confirmed whether they allow externals to own boards (risk to requested workflow). Recommendation: because the request states externals must have persistent access and be able to own/update boards, I recommend Option A ($1,350) to avoid project risk; if you want to save cost I will confirm with the vendor right now whether contractor passes permit board ownership and switch to Option B only if confirmed.
